content:
Chem Progress, headquartered at Via Romagna, 9 – 20098 San Giuliano Milanese (Mi), Italy, is a dynamic and innovative chemical company renowned for its commitment to research, development, and the sustainable production of high-performance chemical solutions. With a strategic location in the industrial heart of Lombardy, Chem Progress has built a strong reputation for delivering advanced specialty chemicals tailored to meet the evolving needs of a diverse range of industries, including pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, agrochemicals, and industrial manufacturing.

Founded with a vision of merging scientific expertise with environmental responsibility, the company operates at the forefront of chemical innovation, utilizing state-of-the-art technologies and rigorous quality control standards. Its R&D department continuously works on optimizing processes and formulating products that align with global safety and ecological regulations, including REACH and ISO standards. This dedication to innovation and quality ensures that Chem Progress maintains a competitive edge in both European and international markets.

The company fosters long-term partnerships by offering customized solutions, technical support, and reliable supply chains, placing customer satisfaction at the core of its mission. With a team composed of highly qualified chemists, engineers, and industry professionals, Chem Progress upholds the principles of sustainability, transparency, and continuous improvement. As it expands its portfolio and market reach, Chem Progress remains deeply rooted in its Italian heritage while embracing a global perspective, striving to contribute positively to technological advancement and environmental stewardship in the chemical industry.
